app.title: EMBERHOLD
hud.hint: Drag to pan · scroll or pinch to zoom · tap a tile to inspect
obstacle.rewardCapped: Reward: {reward} · overflow is lost when storage is full
obstacle.removedNothing: {obstacle} cleared, but nothing fit in storage — {lost} was lost.
obstacle.removeFailed: That obstacle could not be removed. Nothing has changed.
builders.title: Builders
save.blocked: Couldn't save — progress is in memory only
save.unavailable: Saving isn't available in this browser — progress will be lost on reload
save.unreadable: A saved village couldn't be read; it has been left untouched. Saving is off for this session.
save.incompatible: A saved village was made with a different game version; it has been left untouched. Saving is off for this session.
save.clockBehind: This device's clock is behind your saved village, so the game is read-only: actions are unavailable until the clock is corrected and the game reloaded. Nothing has been overwritten.
save.conflict: Another tab saved a newer version of this village, so this tab is now read-only. Reload to continue from the newest save. Nothing from this tab was written.
hud.readOnly: Read-only: correct this device's clock, then reload, to keep playing.
hud.conflict: Read-only: another tab saved a newer village. Reload to continue from it.
shop.title: Build
shop.description: Choose a building, then tap an open tile. Green means valid; red means blocked.
placement.title: Place {building}
placement.instructions: Tap an open tile to start construction.
placement.invalid: Blocked — choose an empty buildable tile
placement.outside: Move over the village to preview placement
placement.wallInstructions: Drag across tiles to place a wall line, or tap a single tile. Release to build. Cancel first to pan by dragging.
wall.partialOne: Placed a wall segment, then stopped: {reason}.
wall.reason.margin: that tile is in the decorative margin
wall.reason.bounds: that tile is outside the village
wall.reason.limit: the wall limit for this Keep is reached
wall.reason.other: that tile cannot be built on
move.title: Move {building}
move.instructions: Tap a buildable tile to place this building there.
move.invalid: Blocked — choose an empty buildable tile
move.outside: Move over the village to choose a destination
move.noop: That building is already there. Pick a different tile or cancel.
collection.storageFull: Storage full — buffered resources were lost
upgrade.working: Your builder is working on this building.
